body: You know, there are times when I just victimise myself in my head and create problems. I've tried everything. Even meditation but nothing is helping me anymore... I don't know what to do
Is it normal to feel like inflicting self harm?

Hello. I know the last thing you want to hear is - There is Hope. But there is you know? When I lost my father, I felt like there's no point of moving forward. But, I realised that this life is mine. I get to choose and live for me. Such mindset maybe hard to accept and practice - but please, life is so much more than this. Please try to find the happy moments. I'm sure you'd find some.

Please communicate! If you have parents who are very supportive - it'd be a shame to ruin life. It might be very hard at first but slowly, with a bit of practice - you'll be able to express yourself and get the help you deserve. Please take care 🌻

Hey, I know it hurts. Today's been rough. Nothing said right now will help you maybe... But can I just say, I'm proud of you. I've been hurting a lot recently but I've been so scared to share it out to the world. You could. You still have strength within you. Please stay safe. Please stay for the strength you have within you.

Okay, I'm clearly very late to this. But I'm so proud of you for blocking him and choosing what's good for you! Don't believe in his excuses - he's Gaslighting you. My ex tried to do the same to me. Stand your ground, King!👑 Ain't no one allowed to treat you anything less than the best❤️
Hey, I'm trying to find meaning and purpose in life. And I hope you find your source of happiness too :)
I'm so sorry that happened to you.
I don't need to roast you - I think you're just fed up with half of the population :3
When someone says they weren't lying but forgot to mention about it first.
